hints.title: Check for Zero to One Transition
hints.text: Because the string starts with 1, a second segment of ones can occur only if substring 01 appears.

hints.title: Substring Search
hints.text: Check whether the two-character pattern 01 appears anywhere in the string.

hints.title: Evaluate Condition
hints.text: If 01 does not appear in s, return true; otherwise return false.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of binary string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space substring search evaluates validity in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that since s[0] == 1, multiple segments require a 01 transition.
